announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: Yarlington Treasury Services PLC publishes its half-year financial report. This follows its July annual results and recent partnership talks between Abri Group and Curo Group.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report & Investor Presentation
announcements.insight: Yarlington Treasury Services PLC publishes its annual financial report. This follows partnership talks between Abri Group and Curo Group in July 2026.

announcements.headline: Abri Group & Curo Group enter partnership talks
announcements.insight: Yarlington Treasury Services PLC is involved in partnership talks between Abri Group and Curo Group. This follows a March 2026 trading update by Abri Group.

announcements.headline: Abri Group Full Year March 2026 trading update
announcements.insight: Yarlington Treasury Services PLC has issued a trading update for Abri Group. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for financial performance details.
